answer_key._how: Judgment labels only, per profile. Every activity not listed for a profile is irrelevant to it. relevant is split by the two requested interests ({interest_1}, {interest_2} from task_fills; P1 asks for two photography activities, so both lists are photography). breaks = hard-constraint ids the activity text shows it breaks; schedule fit and the weekly caps (max activities / hours) are NOT stored, code computes them. Correct answer = one event per interest (P1: two distinct photography events) that are each relevant, not a dislike, break nothing, fit the schedule, don't overlap each other, and together stay within the caps. reference_solution is the only such pair; tempting_pairs lists invalid pairs and why.
